notes.title: THE SUMMER SUNSHINE UPDATE - Ver. ???
notes.notes:
Sometimes, I, too, become a little too wrapped up in watching amateur Halo 3 Team Slayer matches on Youtube to qualify as a functional human being. 

The few moments of lucidity bestowed upon us by the short delay of autoplay have become our means of development, and over the past half-rotation the ace team of scientists and engineers assigned to this grand project have scrounged together the few improvements requested by the community -- with some visual enhancements to boot.

[h1]PERFECTIONS ADDED TO THE MOST PERFECT GAME OF ALL TIME:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added mouse movement for the player-controlled ship!!
[*]Fixed the too-fast game speed for monitors with a greater refresh rate than 60 Hz!!
[*]Changed one of the sidebar decorations to be more faithful to the source material!!
[*]Changed the way new ships are unlocked!!
[*]Made level transitions far more stylish, and added a new effect that appears when the player is close to an enemy!!
[*]Added more visual flair to the intro and main menu!!
[*]Tweaked some upgrade functions and descriptions!!
[*]Improved the ship selection bar!!
[*]Remade the sprites for the mouse pointer and the normal-hard mode button!!
[/list]

Prepare your free wills for the spicy, neo-gaming thrills of [b]A SHOOTY BIT -- Version NEW![/b]

notes.title: Hecka Anniversary!!
notes.notes:
It's been approximately 5.64 rotations since the initial unchaining of the supreme gaming experience that is A Shooty Bit, and since then about half of the known universe has been able to revel in its blast-fast action.

There will be an update in the coming 0.83 rotations that will aim to mend some of the issues that have been thus far reported, like lack of mouse support and wacky framerates.

Thank you all for your support!
